title: Compromised Cardano credentials
description: Payment and stake key or script hashes no merger signer pays or takes from, each with its evidence, and the credentials the list must never deny. An address is denied when either of its credentials is listed; a pointer address cannot be checked and is refused. Beyond this schema a reader must refuse a key repeated in one object, a version written as a fraction (1.0), a hash listed twice in credentials or in allow, and a hash in both.
